QUOTE: Detached async-ask worker | `external_bridge.cpp:1158-1222` (`.detach()`) | Runs `entropic_run` for `entropic.ask(async=true)`; and "`stop()` joins the accept and client threads but not the detached async worker."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as the detached thread and states that it is never joined and can outlive the handle on destroy. It does not explicitly say it is the only detached thread, but every other thread in the table is joined.
